description: This file defines the VoiceOverlayTextFormatting enum with static methods for text comparison and attributed string creation, used in voice overlay UI formatting.

classes.name: VoiceOverlayTextFormatting
classes.description: An enum providing static methods to manage and format voice overlay text, including computing text differences and creating attributed strings.

methods.name: delta(after:committed:current:)
methods.description: Returns the substring of 'current' that comes after the 'committed' prefix if present, otherwise returns 'current'.

methods.name: makeAttributed(committed:volatile:isFinal:)
methods.description: Creates an NSAttributedString combining 'committed' and 'volatile' texts with different styling, indicating whether the final state is set.
